walkthrough:
Calculate the 4th, 5th, and 6th terms of the binomial expansion of $\left(2x - \frac{1}{2x}\right)^5$:
$$T_4 = \binom{5}{3}(2x)^2\left(-\frac{1}{2x}\right)^3 = 10(4x^2)\left(-\frac{1}{8x^3}\right) = -\frac{5}{x}$$
$$T_5 = \binom{5}{4}(2x)^1\left(-\frac{1}{2x}\right)^4 = 5(2x)\left(\frac{1}{16x^4}\right) = \frac{5}{8x^3}$$
$$T_6 = \binom{5}{5}\left(-\frac{1}{2x}\right)^5 = 1\left(-\frac{1}{32x^5}\right) = -\frac{1}{32x^5}$$

hints: Combine $1 \times (20x)$ and $4x^2 \times \left(-\frac{5}{x}\right)$ to find the coefficient of $x$.
walkthrough:
Identify the terms producing $x$ in the product $(1 + 4x^2)\left(32x^5 - 40x^3 + 20x - \frac{5}{x} + \dots\right)$:
$$\text{Term in } x = 1 \times (20x) + 4x^2 \times \left(-\frac{5}{x}\right) = 20x - 20x = 0x$$

State the resulting coefficient:
$$\text{Coefficient of } x = 0$$
